title: 地方菜正在出圈③云南山野火锅：一锅汤，涮下整座山 | Rising Flavors P3 · Yunnan Mountain Hotpot 🍄
description:
菌汤锅还是麻辣锅，你站哪一锅？评论区投票。

【这个夏天·地方菜正在出圈 第3集 云南山野火锅】一锅汤，涮下整座山——这是今年最火的云南火锅。它的锅底不是红油麻辣，而是一锅奶白的菌汤：牛肝菌、松茸片先熬出鲜，再下几十种山茅野菜。低脂、高蛋白，吃的就是那口山野本味。据行业观察，菌菇火锅的年度品类增速超过六成，从云南一路开到北上广深；健康、天然食材的消费占比比2020年提升了约三成——山野火锅正是2025年餐饮的"新顶流"。一口鲜汤，就把整座山喝进了嘴里。

Ep.3 Yunnan. One pot that cooks a whole mountain — this is the hottest Yunnan hotpot right now. The base isn't red-oil spice; it's a milky mushroom broth: boletus and matsutake simmered for umami, then dozens of wild mountain greens. Lean, high-protein, pure mountain flavor. Industry watchers put the mushroom-hotpot category's annual growth above 60%, spreading from Yunnan to every major city — the "new star" of 2025 dining as healthy, natural ingredients keep rising. One sip, and you drink a whole mountain.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food & industry note, not investment advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
